description_en: Open Source Marketplace For Developer Tools
readme_excerpt: arkade - Open Source Marketplace For Developer Tools arkade is how developers install the latest versions of their favourite CLI tools and Kubernetes apps. With arkade get, you'll have kubectl, kind, terraform, and jq on your machine faster than you can type apt-get install or brew update.
